headline.purpose: The single title at the top of an operational screen.

body.purpose: Forms, records, explanations, and response copy.

label.purpose: Field names, definition terms, and compact controls.

numeric.purpose: Counts and monetary results with tabular figures.

motion.name: control-press
motion.purpose: Moves a pressed button down by one pixel.

motion.name: control-fill
motion.purpose: Changes button and navigation fills without a long fade.

motion.name: dialog-enter
motion.purpose: Moves the right-side dialog 12px into place while opacity reaches full strength.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Replaces all animation and transition durations when the user prefers reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next user-reviewed action in a workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 0.08s ease, background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: An alternate, export, reopen, or supporting action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 0.08s ease, background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A lower-priority status or utility action.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 0.08s ease, background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive action used only after explicit confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #74372a; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; background: var(--clay); color: #fff8f3; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 0.08s ease, background 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #8e402f; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled operational field with an external focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; color: var(--text); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-field textarea { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #9b998f; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.75rem; background: #faf9f5; color: var(--text); font: inherit; resize: vertical; } .ds-field textarea:hover { border-color: #9b998f; } .ds-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Panel
components.description: A bounded form, filter, or work area on the mineral canvas.
components.html:
Reporting period

Both dates are included in the report.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; padding: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); background: var(--paper); color: var(--text); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 0.45rem; color: var(--ink); } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #536565; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: The dark workspace bar with a complete six-destination phone grid.
components.html: Growth OSNorthline Studio
components.css: .ds-nav-shell { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(10rem, auto) 1fr auto; align-items: stretch; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-identity { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 0.15rem; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; border-right: 1px solid rgb(243 241 235 / 0.25); } .ds-nav-identity span { color: #c8d8d2; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav { display: flex; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-nav button, .ds-nav-signout { min-height: 54px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid rgb(243 241 235 / 0.18); padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; background: transparent; color: #dce7e2; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav button:not([aria-current='page']):hover, .ds-nav-signout:hover { background: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible, .ds-nav-signout:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e6ad69; outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-nav-signout { border-right: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgb(243 241 235 / 0.25); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-nav-shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } .ds-nav-identity { border-right: 0; } .ds-nav { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: visible; border-top: 1px solid rgb(243 241 235 / 0.25); } .ds-nav-signout { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; } .ds-nav button { white-space: normal; } }

components.name: State Label
components.description: A compact text label for review and workflow state.
components.css: .ds-state-label { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.25rem 0.45rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Register Row
components.description: A divider-led operational record with aligned facts and value.
components.css: .ds-register-row { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1.5fr 1.5fr 0.7fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 1.1rem 0.6rem; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-register-row:hover { background: #dedbd4; } .ds-register-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-register-main { display: grid; gap: 0.3rem; } .ds-register-main strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-register-main span, .ds-register-reason, .ds-register-value { font-size: 0.86rem; } .ds-register-reason { color: var(--clay); font-weight: 700; } .ds-register-value { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-register-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1rem 0.4rem; } .ds-register-value { text-align: left; } }

narrative.overview:
Growth OS uses the visual language of a well-kept appointment register: warm mineral-gray work surfaces, blue-green structure, clear rules, and compact records. The system is built for Operate mode. It favors scan speed, task order, and visible state over decorative display.

The interface stays flat and editorial. Strong headings establish hierarchy, horizontal rules organize evidence, and a small set of semantic colors marks focus, warning, success, and destructive action. It does not use shadows, gradients, glass effects, neon accents, floating card grids, or decorative icon sets.
keyCharacteristics: Warm mineral-gray page and paper layers.
Deep blue-green navigation, headings, links, and primary actions.
Dense registers and ledgers separated by visible rules.
Nearly square controls with explicit focus and state treatments.
A complete two-row phone navigation that keeps every destination visible.

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Ochre and clay must explain focus, warning, validation, priority, or danger. They do not decorate neutral content.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Keep large areas mineral, paper, or blue-green. State colors remain local to the message or action they qualify.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Sans for every interface role. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, tracking, and placement.

rules.name: The Editorial Scale Rule
rules.body: Each screen gets one large heading. Dense task content then steps down to section titles, labels, body copy, and muted metadata.

rules.name: The Register Before Cards Rule
rules.body: Use open rows and dividers for repeated operational records. Use a bordered paper panel only when the content needs a bounded editing or filtering context.

rules.name: The Phone Task Order Rule
rules.body: When a desktop split collapses, place the current work and its result before secondary creation or import tools.

rules.name: The Divider Depth Rule
rules.body: Use color fields and rules to separate layers. Do not add shadows, blur, glass, or gradients.

rules.name: The Near-Square Rule
rules.body: Default to square corners or the 2px control radius. Do not introduce pills, oversized rounding, or floating capsules.

rules.name: The Explicit State Rule
rules.body: Every selected, active, pending, success, warning, and destructive state needs a visible label, copy change, border, or fill change.

rules.name: The Manual Action Rule
rules.body: Primary buttons identify the next user-reviewed action. Secondary and quiet buttons hold alternate, export, reopen, or status-marking actions.

dos: Do keep screen titles large and singular, then use dense section-level hierarchy below them.
Do use strong horizontal dividers to organize records, metrics, history, and response work.
Do preserve all six destinations in the phone navigation's two-row grid.
Do keep the 44px minimum action height, visible ochre focus outline, and reduced-motion override.
Do use stored-state language and semantic color together so meaning survives without color.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass effects, neon accents, or blurred layers.
Don't turn repeated records into a floating rounded card grid.
Don't add decorative icon libraries where text labels or native disclosure markers already explain the action.
Don't use ochre or clay as broad brand fills without a focus, warning, validation, priority, or danger meaning.
Don't hide phone destinations behind a menu when the complete two-row navigation fits.
